A '''story platform''' was a type of [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] that was used to display interactive stories to children.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|194|story platform}}</ref> [[Shannon Voorson]] owned a story platform, which she used to view ''[[Vici of Alderaan]]''.<ref name="SD">{{JournalCite|9|Slaying Dragons}}</ref>
